text:
This looks like mid-2022 to early 2023. CPI is very high in z-score terms, core CPI is high, and the 2-year yield has risen sharply over 3 and 12 months. The policy rate is only slightly below its 3-year average, which means it is still low relative to the window. The spread is falling fast, consistent with a hiking cycle. The unemployment rate is low.

A policy rate z of -0.5 with a 3-year window that includes 2020-21 near-zero rates puts this in spring 2022. The 2-year yield is +1.0 and was up 2.5 over 3 months, which fits March-April 2022. Equities show a 3m return of -1.5 and 12m of -0.5, which fits roughly April-May 2022. Investment-grade credit at -2.0 on 3m and 1m -1.0 fits April 2022, when bonds fell sharply. Gold at +1.5 for the month would fit March 2022, but gold was down in April. The 10-year at z +1.0 with a 3m change of +1.5 fits March-April 2022.

The 12m change in the policy rate is only +0.5, so the fed funds rate was still low. The 1m equity return of 0.0 suggests March 2022, when equities rose about 3% (S&P up ~3.7%) and gold rose in the month. However, the 1m equity z-score of 0 against a 3m of -1.5 fits March, since January-February were weak. IG credit at -1.0 for the month fits March 2022 as yields spiked. I'll go with March 2022.
